# Nova API — /api/notebooks

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/notebooks`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## GET /api/notebooks

Operation id `notebooks_list`: in Python `client.call("notebooks_list", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api notebooks_list`.

`GET /api/notebooks`: the latest version of every notebook in the caller's groups, newest first. Administrators see their own groups only.

The latest published version of every notebook in the caller's groups, newest first. Each row carries the group, the name, the latest `objectVersion`, its size, `uploadedAt` as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC (SeaweedFS's RFC 1123 `LastModified` normalised) and the publisher's `uploadedBy` display name. An administrator gets no wider view than their own groups. Unset `NOVA_S3_*` is 503; an S3 that is down or refuses is 502. Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | One row per notebook |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `502` | The notebook store did not answer |
| `503` | Notebook storage is not configured |

## PUT /api/notebooks/\{group\}/\{name\}

Operation id `notebooks_publish`: in Python `client.call("notebooks_publish", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api notebooks_publish`.

`PUT /api/notebooks/{group}/{name}`: validate, strip, store one immutable version.

Publish a notebook as a new immutable object version in the `notebooks` bucket. Needs a signed-in person whose groups include `{group}` (403 `you are not a member of the group <g>`; administrators are not exempt). `{name}` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._ -]{0,127}\.ipynb$` and the body must be an nbformat 4 notebook of at most 5 MiB. Every code cell's `outputs` is emptied and its `execution_count` set to null, and the notebook's widget metadata is removed, before storing — no cell output reaches the object store. A cell of an nbformat 4.5 notebook without an `id` gets one (`cell-<position>`), so the stored notebook stays valid nbformat. `sha256` is of the stored (stripped) bytes. `parameters` are the `name = literal` lines of the first cell tagged `parameters`, at most 32; defaults are text and are never evaluated. A 61st publish by one person in an hour is 429. Publishing bytes the newest version already holds stores nothing, uses no slot and writes no audit line: the answer names that version with `unchanged: true`. With `?dryRun=true` the same checks run and nothing is stored, no slot is used and no audit line is written: the answer says `unchanged: true` with the newest version, or `unchanged: false` with an empty `objectVersion` when a publish would store a new one. Unset `NOVA_S3_*` is 503 `notebook storage is not configured`; an S3 that is down or refuses is 502. Each publish that stores a version writes one audit line with group, name, version and size, never content. A version published with an `X-Stardelt-Source` header carries `source` (`repository`, `commit`, `path`, `clean`); Nova stores it and does not verify it against a Git server.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dryRun` | query | boolean | No | `true`: validate the notebook and say whether the newest version already holds these bytes, without storing a version, using a publish slot or writing an audit line. |
| `group` | path | string | Yes | One of the caller's groups |
| `name` | path | string | Yes | Notebook file name, ending in.ipynb |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The stored version and its parsed parameters; `unchanged: true` when the newest version already held these bytes; an empty `objectVersion` only on a dry run that would store a new version |
| `400` | Bad name or not an nbformat 4 notebook |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | Not a member of the group |
| `413` | Larger than 5 MiB |
| `429` | More than 60 publishes in an hour |
| `502` | The notebook store did not answer |
| `503` | Notebook storage is not configured |

## DELETE /api/notebooks/\{group\}/\{name\}

Operation id `notebooks_delete`: in Python `client.call("notebooks_delete", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api notebooks_delete`.

`DELETE /api/notebooks/{group}/{name}`: the notebook and every version of it.

Delete a published notebook and every version of it from the `notebooks` bucket; the bucket is versioned, so each version is removed by its id and the bytes are gone, not hidden. Needs a signed-in person whose groups include `{group}` (403 `you are not a member of the group <g>`; administrators are not exempt). A notebook with no version is 404 `no such notebook`. The answer carries the number of versions removed. A schedule that pinned a deleted version fails its next run. Unset `NOVA_S3_*` is 503 `notebook storage is not configured`; an S3 that is down or refuses is 502 (a retry removes what is left). Each delete writes one audit line with group, name and the number of versions, never content. Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | path | string | Yes | One of the caller's groups |
| `name` | path | string | Yes | Notebook file name, ending in.ipynb |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The notebook and the number of versions removed |
| `400` | Bad name |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | Not a member of the group |
| `404` | No such notebook |
| `502` | The notebook store did not answer |
| `503` | Notebook storage is not configured |

## GET /api/notebooks/\{group\}/\{name\}/content

Operation id `notebooks_content`: in Python `client.call("notebooks_content", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api notebooks_content`.

`GET /api/notebooks/{group}/{name}/content`: one stored version's bytes, as they are, so the notebook page can preview what a schedule would run.

One published version's stored bytes, answered `application/json` as they are. The bytes are the notebook Nova stored: outputs emptied, `execution_count` null, so a preview of a published version shows source and markdown only. `?version=<id>` names the immutable version; omitted, the latest is read. Needs a member of `{group}` (403 `you are not a member of the group <g>`; administrators are not exempt). An unknown version is 404 `no such notebook version`. Unset `NOVA_S3_*` is 503 `notebook storage is not configured`; an S3 that is down or refuses is 502. Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`.

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | path | string | Yes | One of the caller's groups |
| `name` | path | string | Yes | Notebook file name, ending in.ipynb |
| `version` | query | string | No |  |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The stored notebook bytes |
| `400` | Bad name |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | Not a member of the group |
| `404` | No such notebook version |
| `502` | The notebook store did not answer |

## GET /api/notebooks/\{group\}/\{name\}/parameters

Operation id `notebooks_parameters`: in Python `client.call("notebooks_parameters", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api notebooks_parameters`.

`GET /api/notebooks/{group}/{name}/parameters`: the parameters of one version, so the Schedule dialog can offer the form the notebook declares.

The parameters of one published version of a notebook, read from the stored bytes: the `name = literal` lines of the first cell tagged `parameters`, in order, at most 32, defaults as text and never evaluated. `?version=<id>` names the immutable version; omitted, the latest is read and its id answered. Needs a member of `{group}` (403 `you are not a member of the group <g>`; administrators are not exempt). An unknown version is 404 `no such notebook version`. The answer carries `parameters` and the `objectVersion` it describes — a schedule pins that id. Unset `NOVA_S3_*` is 503 `notebook storage is not configured`; an S3 that is down or refuses is 502. Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | path | string | Yes | One of the caller's groups |
| `name` | path | string | Yes | Notebook file name, ending in.ipynb |
| `version` | query | string | No |  |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The parameters and the version they belong to |
| `400` | Bad name |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | Not a member of the group |
| `404` | No such notebook version |

## GET /api/notebooks/\{group\}/\{name\}/usage

Operation id `notebooks_usage`: in Python `client.call("notebooks_usage", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api notebooks_usage`.

The pipelines that run one published notebook — the schedules and on-demand pipelines of that group, sorted by name. Each row is the one-task `Pipeline` a Schedule created: its pinned `objectVersion`, its cron and timezone when it has a schedule, and its `runAs`. Owner-group scoped: a caller who is not a member of `group` answers 403, and an administrator gets no wider view. Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | path | string | Yes | The notebook's owner group |
| `name` | path | string | Yes | The notebook's `.ipynb` file name |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The visible schedules, sorted by name |
| `401` | No token to sign in with |
| `403` | The caller is not a member of the group |
| `502` | The cluster did not answer |
| `503` | No cluster connection |

## GET /api/notebooks/\{group\}/\{name\}/versions

Operation id `notebooks_versions`: in Python `client.call("notebooks_versions", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api notebooks_versions`.

`GET /api/notebooks/{group}/{name}/versions`: the versions of one notebook, newest first, at most 50.

The published versions of one notebook, newest first, at most 50. Needs a member of `{group}` (403 `you are not a member of the group <g>`; administrators are not exempt). Each row carries the immutable `objectVersion`, its size, `uploadedAt` as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC (SeaweedFS's RFC 1123 `LastModified` normalised), the publisher's `uploadedBy` and the `sha256` of the stored bytes. A group with no such notebook answers an empty list. Unset `NOVA_S3_*` is 503; an S3 that is down or refuses is 502. Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`. A version published with an `X-Stardelt-Source` header carries `source` (`repository`, `commit`, `path`, `clean`); Nova stores it and does not verify it against a Git server.

| `name` | path | string | Yes | Notebook file name, ending in.ipynb |

| `400` | Bad name |
